items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Now I recorded it with Richard Jones... And so Richard Jones on piano, one time he had the band... So the next job Roy gave me was playing with Tick Chambers, Richard Jones, and myself

ctx.x: What was it like to be on the radio?

On the radio? Well, I imagine a fella, speaking personally, a fella's inclined to tighten up on making records on the radio. I know I always do. I've never played my best on any radio or either records. I don't know why. I don't know, it just seemed to get kind of nervous, you know, you want to do your best, and one of those things, you know. And you're not there, you just don't play as, at least I don't, as freely as you like to play, or as you can play. See, because you know a thousand people's going to hear…
He should have taken some muscle tone.
